title: Randomized Estimation of T-Eigenvalues of T-SPD Tensors: A Two-Sided Bracket
summary: In earlier work \cite{sharma2025} we developed deterministic analytical bounds on the T-eigenvalues of symmetric positive definite (SPD) third-order tensors under the Kilmer--Martin T-product: the trace--determinant (TDet) bounds via the AM--GM inequality, and the trace-dependent (TDep) bounds generalizing Samuelson's inequality. While these bounds are cheap and guaranteed-valid, their relative gap grows as $\sqrt{d-1}$ in the tensor dimension $d = np$, limiting their usefulness for large tensors.
